prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1210; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you were involved in while driving in Pasadena, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state where you were headed when the collision happened.

A: I was on my way home from a shift. I was driving on the main road through town, in the right lane, going at a normal speed for the traffic.

Q: What was traffic like at that point?

A: It was moving but slowing down. The car in front of me stopped at a light, and I came to a stop behind it, maybe a few car lengths back.

Q: Did you have any warning before the impact?

A: Not really. I looked up at the light and then heard tires and felt a hard jolt from behind. My car lurched forward and hit the one in front of me, so it was a bit of a chain.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you notice any injuries right away?

A: My right wrist hurt immediately. I had my hand on the wheel and it felt like something gave way. The pain got worse over the next hour, and it was swelling up by the time I got to the emergency room.

Q: Has a doctor confirmed the injury?

A: Yes. They took X-rays and told me the wrist is fractured. I have a splint and I'm waiting to see a specialist about whether I need a cast or surgery.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car looked at and get my wrist treated.

Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
